turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
...I guess they brought me in. From work. At the warehouse. 

They said I was... doing things. Like freezing. By the forklift, with my arms up. Or copying the beeping sounds. And the hand signals. I was just... moving boxes in these little patterns. Everyone kept yelling at me to stop, but... yeah. They sent me here.

symptom_reasoning.S022: The patient describes freezing with arms up (posturing), copying sounds and hand signals (echolalia and echopraxia), and moving boxes in strange patterns (stereotypy), which are all clear examples of disorganized or abnormal motor behavior.

turns.doctor_question: When you were standing there at the warehouse, were you hearing any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
turns.patient_response: ...No. Just the normal stuff. The forklift beeping. I don't... I didn't hear voices. Just what was there.

symptom_reasoning.S020: The patient explicitly denies hearing voices or sounds that others couldn't hear.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any changes in your memory or your ability to think clearly lately?

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any recent head injuries, seizures, or sudden changes in your physical health?

turns.doctor_question: When you were standing there at the warehouse with your arms up, did you feel like you were physically unable to move or speak, even if you wanted to?

turns.doctor_question: When you were copying the beeping sounds or the hand signals at the warehouse, did you feel like you were doing it automatically, almost as if you were mirroring what you saw or heard without being able to stop yourself?
turns.patient_response: ...I don't know about automatic. I guess that's why they brought me in, though. I just... keep doing it. Copying the beeps and the signals. Or I just... freeze up by the forklift with my arms up. Sometimes I move the boxes in these... strange little patterns. Even when everyone is yelling at me to stop, I just... I don't stop. I don't really know why.

symptom_reasoning.S022: The patient describes freezing in postures, copying sounds and movements (echolalia/echopraxia), and moving objects in strange patterns despite being told to stop, which are clear signs of disorganized or abnormal motor behavior.
